QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts] Do Wondroids Dream of Mechanized Mushrooms?
QuestInfo.0: #bSpencer#k wants to tell you the dark secret #bAspire#k is hiding about the production of the #bWondroid#k.
QuestInfo.1: Go to #bAspire#k and find out what #bSpencer#k has to say.
QuestInfo.2: On your tour of #bAspire Industries#k with #bSpencer#k,\r\nhe hinted that there are far more sinister means of creating #bWondroids#k than the public is aware\r\nof. Investigate further, and you may just uncover the shocking truth.
